description:
FILED s473t5d (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 5 CHECK 2.

After #1700 and #1699 t/run/switches.t runs to its end: 28 pass / 112 fail,
shortfall 35 -> 11.  The residue is ONE family -- PCL's `pcl` driver implements
`-e/-E/-I/-M/-c/-w/-v` (docs/pcl-commands.md) and nothing else, and this file
is perl's specification of the REST:

  20 rows  `-N correctly unknown` / `-N unrecognised on #! line` x 10 letters:
           perl prints "Unrecognized switch: -A  (-h will show valid options)"
           and exits 1; PCL accepts and ignores every unknown switch.
  ~10      -V, -V:osname, -V:unknown, -V:re, -v, -h, -?: the version/config
           dumps and the usage text.
   6       -0 / -00 / -0777 / -0 after a -l / -0 before a -l / "$/ set at
           compile-time" / "-g undefines $/": the switch must set $/ AT COMPILE
           TIME (a BEGIN block must already see it).
   8       the -m/-M ERROR forms: `-M:Foo not allowed`, `-mFoo:Bar not
           allowed`, `-m-`, `-M-`, and `#!perl -m` / `#!perl -M`.
   3       -s (and -sn) switch parsing into %main::.
   2       -c ("syntax OK" on stderr) and -x on the #! line.
  ~30      the `... on #! line` family -> #1702.
  ~13      the in-place (-i) rows that now RUN but assert perl's backup
           renaming failures (`fail backup rename`, `fail final rename`,
           `no extra files`) -- these are the in-place edit's error paths.

NOT ONE FIX.  The cheap, self-contained piece is the UNKNOWN SWITCH: perl
refuses it loudly, PCL ignores it, and that is 20 of the 112 rows plus a real
usability point for `pcl` (a typo in a switch today runs the program anyway).
The `-V`/`-v`/`-h` dumps are a product decision about what `pcl --version`
should print in perl's format.  The compile-time `$/` half belongs with #1702
(both are "a switch rewrites the program before it is compiled").

ROWS: 112 blessed fail rows + 11 shortfall.


=== DONE (s506f, Opus, 2026-10-04; resumed s507, final bars on 3756b678 = main d23b5927 + the batch, branch worktree-agent-a908d9d2d9fff4ce2) ===
perl's command-line switches in `pcl`: ONE parser (tools/lib/PCLSwitches.pm parse_argv: clusters, `--`, `-`, stdin program, perl's switch errors, status 25) and ONE expansion in pl2cl (`--switches=HEX` merged with the program's own #! line, perlrun's equivalents on the first code line, no line moves).  Table: docs/pcl-commands.md; what differs: docs/not-supported.md "Perl's command-line switches".  -n -p -a -F -l -0 -g -i -s -x -S -E -I -M -m -c -w -C implemented; -T/-t run + announced; -W -X -U -f inert; -D perl's message; -d -u refused; -v = version, -V/-V:name from %Config, -h/-?; a script's #! line honoured (#1702).  Guards: Pl/t/pcl-switches-01.t (122 rows), tools/t/harness-switches.t rows 5-11, Pl/t/script-cache-01.t (+5).  One-liner battery 147 of 152 (ol-052 #2665, ol-062/064 #2664, ol-161/164 smartmatch).  Companion: run/switches.t 29/111 -> 125/15, switchC 3/12 -> 12/3, switchx 0/2 -> 7/1, switch0 OK, switchI 0/4 -> 2/2, re/recompile.t 0/48 -> 24/24.  Sweep TOTAL 18728 -> 18731.  EVERYDAY 113 -> 113.  Residue: #2660-#2670 (#1709's switch residue = #2667).
